place: cracked blue ice with a huge planet in the sky

story.title: This Moon Crawler Flies on Winged Shells
story.signature_move: It hovers silently overhead on bat wings before dropping down to snap a Europa ice-worm with its huge pincers.
story.hybrid_look: This creature has a wide, flat armoured shell and a hard red carapace mixed with fur texture, featuring a bat-shaped head with the crab's eyes, eight bent walking legs, two huge claws, two huge pincers, bat wings, and a thin tail, moving as it scuttles sideways with claws high, hovers off the ground, and beats its wings.

sentences.text: This armored beast drops from the dark skies of Europa to hunt.
sentences.image: a dark icy canyon beneath a massive distant gas giant planet

sentences.text: Meet the imaginary Cryocrab, blending the flight of a bat and the armor of a crab.
sentences.image: vast frozen plains reflecting faint starlight across barren blue ice

sentences.text: It hovers silently overhead on bat wings before dropping down to snap a Europa ice-worm with its huge pincers.
sentences.image: deep chasms filled with swirling blue gas and jagged frost spires

sentences.text: Freezing temperatures threaten to freeze body fluids, but its thick furry red carapace locks in internal heat.
sentences.image: sub-zero vapor clouds blowing across a desolate frozen wasteland

sentences.text: Low gravity makes walking difficult, so its eight bent legs provide maximum traction on slick ice.
sentences.image: steep glacial walls covered in shimmering frost crystals under a dark sky

sentences.text: Total darkness blinds most hunters, yet it uses echolocation clicks to track hidden movement beneath the crust.
sentences.image: pitch black underground ice tunnels lit only by faint mineral glow

sentences.text: Despite all its adaptations, it cannot survive high heat, and will completely melt if exposed to a warm volcanic vent. What should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
sentences.image: steaming sulfur vents bubbling up through cracks in the thick ice
